label: Country Pop
description: plainspoken country storytelling with a polished, memorable pop chorus.

client_references.explanation: Plainspoken country narrative delivered with a polished, memorable pop chorus.

production_traits.musical_identity: country pop: plainspoken country storytelling over live-feeling acoustic and clean electric guitar, with a polished, memorable pop chorus
instrumentation: acoustic rhythm guitar driving the song
fiddle or pedal steel as tasteful punctuation, never parody
production_traits.rhythm: steady 4/4 with a firm backbeat and a pop chorus that opens up; the pre-chorus tightens rather than speeds up

tempo.note: lower end for a lived-in verse, upper end only when the story already carries momentum

production_traits.vocal_delivery: clear, grounded narrative lead with a strong sung chorus; country inflection only where it is compatible with the client's accepted voice, dry upfront vocal

energy_map.consequence: acoustic guitar and voice state a concrete lived-in consequence
energy_map.obstacle: verse names the behaviour and the friction, kit enters lightly
energy_map.choice: pre-chorus tightens pressure over the actual decision
energy_map.change: chorus opens after the character acts
energy_map.hook: polished pop chorus repeats the emotional proposition
energy_map.cta: bridge exposes the mistaken belief, final resolved chorus carries the CTA

production_traits.hook_guidance: one memorable sung chorus stating the emotional proposition; the bridge reverses the mistaken belief before a more resolved final chorus
production_traits.spoken_sung_split: spoken dialogue is brief and intentional; sung verses and the chorus carry the melody; no rap passages
production_traits.delivery_constraints: never impose an accent, biography or regional stereotype; preserve the client's accepted voice, language and gender
production_traits.word_fit: short idiomatic lines with space for consonants and hook vowels; the chorus repeats one proposition, not several offers
production_traits.story_energy: grounded and rising; the lift belongs to the acted decision, not to an automatic stadium finish

duration_guidance.60: verse, pre-chorus, one full chorus and the CTA; the decision and the chorus stay adjacent
duration_guidance.90: two verses around one chorus plus a short resolved tag
duration_guidance.120: verse, pre-chorus, chorus, one bridge exposing the mistaken belief, final chorus
duration_guidance.180: add a second scene before the bridge and one fiddle or steel answer
duration_guidance.300: three scenes, a quiet third verse, an earned key lift in the last chorus
duration_guidance.600: full arc with a second act and a reprise that resolves the CTA; new consequential beats only

examples: A shopkeeper turns an open sign to closed; the choice to make one honest call drives a drum-and-guitar lift.

section_hint: [Verse] plainspoken, [Pre-Chorus] pressure tightens, [Chorus] pop payoff, [Bridge] mistaken belief
negative_constraints: no inferred accent or regional stereotype
no new owner fact invented for the chorus
